definitions.name: Owned feed (RSS / JSON Feed)
definitions.notes: The hub's own feeds (JSON Feed 1.1 and RSS 2.0), served by the public process. Readable by feed bots, n8n, Zapier, IFTTT and Discord feed bots.

definitions.name: Discord announcements channel
definitions.notes: Execute Webhook: content up to 2000 characters; embed description 4096, all embeds 6000 (docs.discord.com, Webhook and Message resources, 2026-10-25). Always send allowed_mentions {"parse": []}. Discord's character unit is not documented; code points (verify against a live send). The webhook URL is a secret.

definitions.name: Discord social-feed mirror
definitions.notes: A channel mirroring every published post, which other bots can read. Same limits as DISCORD_ANNOUNCEMENTS.

definitions.name: Discord per-package channel
definitions.notes: One target per package or tool channel (a development log). Same limits as DISCORD_ANNOUNCEMENTS.

definitions.name: Telegram channel
definitions.notes: sendMessage text 1-4096 characters after entity parsing, offsets in UTF-16 code units; HTML mode tags b/strong, i/em, u/ins, s/strike/del, span.tg-spoiler/tg-spoiler, a, tg-emoji, tg-time, code, pre, blockquote; only the entities < > & " (core.telegram.org/bots/api, 2026-10-25). The bot must be a channel admin with 'post messages'; honour retry_after on 429.

definitions.name: Bluesky
definitions.notes: app.bsky.feed.post text: maxGraphemes 300, maxLength 3000 (bytes); links are clickable only through richtext facets whose indices count bytes of the UTF-8 text (atproto lexicons, 2026-10-25). Posting uses an app password.

definitions.name: Mastodon
definitions.notes: The limit is per instance: read /api/v2/instance configuration.statuses.max_characters (500 is Mastodon's default) and characters_reserved_per_url (23). Mastodon counts grapheme clusters of the spoiler text plus the text, every URL as 23 and a remote mention as its local part only (StatusLengthValidator, mastodon/mastodon main, 2026-10-25). POST /api/v1/statuses accepts an Idempotency-Key, kept for up to 1 hour.

definitions.name: X
definitions.notes: Disabled: the API is pay-per-use only for new developers (price per created post $0.015, $0.20 with a URL: verify at C6). Until a budget exists, posts go out by the web intent (x.com/intent/tweet with text and url, docs.x.com Web Intent, 2026-10-25). Weighted counting: 280, every URL 23 (t.co), NFC, emoji 2 (docs.x.com counting-characters).

definitions.name: Farcaster
definitions.notes: Evaluate only (limited free tier via Neynar). A cast's text is at most 320 bytes; a long cast is 321 to 1024 bytes (snapchain src/core/validations/cast.rs, 2026-10-25). Who may send long casts: verify.

definitions.name: Reddit
definitions.notes: Manual: new Data API access needs pre-approval under the Responsible Builder Policy. Title 300 characters, text post 40000 (third-party references agree; no official page found, verify). The submit link's query parameters are long-standing but undocumented (verify).

definitions.name: Bitcointalk
definitions.notes: Manual (no write API), BBCode. Subject and message limits are not published (verify in the composer before relying on one); no limit is enforced here.

definitions.name: Developer forums
definitions.notes: Mostly Discourse (one target per forum, its base URL in the target's external_ref). Discourse's new-topic link takes title and body (verify per forum version).

definitions.name: YouTube
definitions.notes: Manual uploads. Title 100 characters, description 5000 (YouTube Help 'Edit video details', 2026-10-25).

definitions.name: Blog
definitions.notes: Articles on the operator's own site; an API publisher may come later.

definitions.name: KOL content
definitions.notes: Content by third parties, tracked with external_status proposed / confirmed / published.

definitions.name: Audio events
definitions.notes: Live audio (for example X Spaces, which has no create API).

definitions.name: Sui Directory
definitions.notes: Project submission form, admin-reviewed (sui.directory/submit-project).

definitions.name: Ecosystem trackers
definitions.notes: Cross-chain project trackers; some have no submission flow and are contacted directly.

definitions.name: DappRadar

cost_model.note: paid fast-track listing exists; price not recorded (verify)

definitions.notes: Developer-dashboard submission with a review period; airdrops and incentives tracked through metrics.

definitions.name: Dapp directories
definitions.notes: Other dapp directories, one target each.

definitions.name: Airdrop directories
definitions.notes: Listings of incentive programmes, one target each.

definitions.name: On-chain badges
definitions.notes: Badges and attestations; the instance records object IDs or explorer URLs.

definitions.name: Crypto ad networks

cost_model.note: per-network minimums differ; every budget is 0 until the operator raises it

definitions.notes: Campaigns tracked manually (metrics entered by hand), one target per network.

definitions.name: Web3 ad networks

cost_model.note: per-network minimums differ; every budget is 0 until the operator raises it

definitions.notes: Campaigns tracked manually, one target per network.

definitions.name: Brave Ads

cost_model.note: self-serve minimum spend applies (sources disagree; verify)

definitions.notes: Self-serve campaigns, tracked manually.

definitions.name: Sui Foundation
definitions.notes: Co-marketing and ecosystem programmes.

definitions.name: Agencies
definitions.notes: Marketing or PR agencies, one target each.

definitions.name: MCP Registry
definitions.notes: Metadata only: publish the package first, then server.json with mcp-publisher (from CI). Namespace proven by GitHub or a domain.

definitions.name: MCP directories
definitions.notes: Aggregators that crawl the registry and let the owner claim a listing; one target each.

definitions.name: Agent directories
definitions.notes: Reviewed connector and app directories of AI assistants.

definitions.name: Hugging Face
definitions.notes: Spaces (a Gradio app can expose an MCP server).

definitions.name: Move Registry (MVR)
definitions.notes: Mainnet only; names need a SuiNS name.

definitions.name: Package source verification
definitions.notes: Move package source verification on explorers; needs git-based dependencies.

definitions.name: Awesome lists
definitions.notes: Curated lists that accept pull requests, one target each.

definitions.name: Walrus Sites
definitions.notes: Trustless mirrors of the frontends (mainnet sites with a SuiNS name are served by wal.app).

definitions.name: Documentation (generated)
definitions.notes: Tracking only: documentation generated from the repositories.

definitions.name: Hub publisher
definitions.notes: The hub's own publishing worker, recorded for provenance.

definitions.name: Automation frameworks
definitions.notes: IFTTT, Zapier, n8n and similar, which consume the owned feeds (nothing is pushed to them).
